name: The Decision Record
summary: A memorandum identity that places the requested decision before its reasoning and keeps the evidence available for inspection.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style Subtitle.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style Subtitle.

recognitionRules: Use a compact title, recipient and date before the recommendation.
Keep Calibri headings and black reading text, with navy table headers, white header labels and pale alternating rows.
Separate evidence, limits and next action into clearly named sections.
Treat the evidence appendix as an extension of the same record, preserving IDs and terminology.

principles: Move from observation to interpretation to a bounded next question.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Make the decision visible. Keep the reason close.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid “proves” when the material only supports a hypothesis.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: A record suggests a direction; it does not speak for every person.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE DECISION RECORD in bold Calibri with a thin horizontal rule and a small record number. No seal or approval checkmark.
invariants: Use a compact title, recipient and date before the recommendation.
Keep Calibri headings and black reading text, with navy table headers, white header labels and pale alternating rows.
Separate evidence, limits and next action into clearly named sections.
adaptations: Brief and appendix editions share one identity.
A short memo may link evidence rather than reproduce it, while preserving the decision text.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
